title: HOW WRONG MIGHT WE BE?

lists.name: Claims
lists.of: claim about how wrong we might be
items: BANNING CHEMICAL & BIOLOGICAL WARFARE MAY HAVE BEEN A TRAGIC MISTAKE (SINCE OTHERWISE GROUND WAR MAY HAVE BECOME IMPOSSIBLE OR HAVE BEEN ABANDONED AS TOO GHASTLY OR ABSURD)
THERE ARE AT LEAST 14 POSSIBLE REASONS WHY 1 + 1 ≠ 2
THE SUN MAY HAVE A HIGH PROBABILITY OF BECOMING UNSTABLE & DESTROYING MAN OVER THE NEXT CENTURY OR MILLENNIA (DESPITE ITS RECORD OVER PAST EONS)
LIFE MAY HAVE ORIGINATED NOT ON LAND OR IN THE SEA BUT IN CLOUDS, AS METHANOGENIC ARCHAEBACTERIA (E.G., CARL R. WOESE)
OUR SENSE OF TIME MAY BE RUNNING “BACKWARDS”
TIME MAY BE INVERTED, & MAY HAVE A CENTER
TIME MAY NOT HAVE ANY INTRINSIC MEANING, & MAY BE INFINITESIMAL OR ZERO (E.G., EUGENE WIGNER)
THE WORLD'S PROPOSITIONS MAY BE TRUE & FALSE INSTANTLY & ETERNALLY
COURSES MAY BE INALTERABLY DETERMINISTIC OR PREDETERMINED
ANYTHING BUT THE MOST IMPORTANT THING IN LIFE MAY BE AN IRRELEVANT TRANSIENT COSMIC EVENT
WE MAY HAVE ALL-IMPORTANT OBLIGATIONS TO POSTERITY
DEMOCRACY MAY BE A VERY BAD SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT
SOME TSUNAMIS MAY BE DUE NOT TO QUAKES BUT TO GAS RELEASED FROM THE SEA BOTTOM
SLOWING THE ARMS RACE MAY PROLONG OR AGGRAVATE THE PERILOUS TRANSITION TO AN UNARMED WORLD
MODERN MEDICINE'S NET EFFECT MAY BE TO INCREASE MAN'S MISERY
REDSHIFTS MAY BE DUE TO PHOTON DECAY, NOT COSMIC EXPANSION (I. SEGAL)
CONTRACYCLICAL ECONOMICS MAY BE WRONG
INTELLIGENCE MAY NOT DEVELOP BUT BURST FORTH EVEN CENTRAL—MAY BE UTTERLY PREFORMED AT BIRTH (E.G., NOAM CHOMSKY)
THE START OF THE UNIVERSE MAY HAVE BEEN INFINITELY COMPLEX, ALL MAY HAVE HAPPENED ALREADY & THE FUTURE MAY BE BUT A MINOR POSTLUDE
MEMORY & THOUGHT MAY BE LARGELY ENVIRONMENTAL, NOT INTRAORGANISMAL
GOOD SPOUSES & MARRIAGES MAY BE DISCOVERED, NOT NATURAL
THE MOST FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR LIFE IN THE UNIVERSE MAY BE THE INTERIOR OF STARS
WE MAY BE DOING EVERYTHING WRONG OR DOING ALL THE WRONG THINGS
EVERYTHING IN SCIENCE, EN BLOC MAY BE COMPLETELY WRONG
BEAUTY & UGLINESS MAY BE BASED ON EXTRINSIC & REASSIGNABLE CHANCE
EVERYONE MAY HAVE MESSIANIC RESPONSIBILITIES OR TOO FEW
THE BASIC SOURCE OF THE SUN'S ENERGY MAY NOT BE NUCLEAR OR THE BETHE CYCLES
3-DIMENSIONALITY OF PHYSICAL SPACE MAY BE A BIOLOGICAL ILLUSION (“BIOMORPHISM”: E.G., HENRI POINCARÉ)
INFLUENZA MAY BE CRITICAL TO THE GENETIC HEALTH OF HOMO SAPIENS & ERADICATING IT A GRIEVOUS ERROR
THE UNIVERSE MAY BE EXPLODING & CONTRACTING; OR EVEN BE IMPLODING—THROUGHOUT—SIMULTANEOUSLY
SOME ETHICAL QUESTIONS MAY BE INHERENTLY UNANSWERABLE (E.G., LOGICALLY UNDECIDABLE, PHYSICALLY MEANINGLESS)
KINDNESS ALONE MAY MATTER
NATURAL SUBSTANCES RATHER THAN ARTIFICIAL ADDITIVES MAY BE THE MOST TOXIC PART OF OUR DIET
THE UNIVERSE MAY CONSIST NOT OF “REAL” BUT OF “COMPLEX” NUMBERS (IN TERMS OF ROGER PENROSE'S TWISTORS)
WE MAY NOT REPRESENT THE SELF TRUTH & SELF-PROBABILITY MAY BE FRACTIONAL
SILENCES MAY CONSTITUTE THE MAJOR PART OF HUMAN COMMUNICATION, & THEY—NOT WORDS—MAY CONSTITUTE OUR LANGUAGE
THE SELF MAY NOT EXIST (PACE RENÉ DESCARTES: IF “GOD” EXISTS, IT MAY BE AN INFINITELY HIDEOUS PERVERT OR ABSOLUTE EVIL)
EVERYTHING (EVERY QUANTUM, INTEGER, EVENT, IDEA) MAY BE INFINITELY COMPLEX
ALL STATES MAY BE WRONG & THEIR EXISTENCE UNJUSTIFIED
POLITICAL SYSTEMS MAY BE REDUNDANT & THEIR EXISTENCE UNJUSTIFIED
THE SELF MAY BE DIVISIBLE INTO A MULTITUDE OF “SELVES” OR DISSIMILAR ENTITIES (POLYPSYCHISM) SIMULTANEOUSLY
LYING MAY BE IMPOSSIBLE (DUE TO EXCESSIVE INFORMATION OR PSYCHOLOGICAL LAWS)
EARTHLIFE MAY HAVE ORIGINATED FROM GARBAGE OR BODILY WASTES LEFT BEHIND BY COSMIC VISITORS EONS AGO
WAR MAY BE A DESIRABLE SPORT, ENTERTAINMENT, EXPERIENCE OR PSYCHO-BIOLOGICAL FULFILLMENT (THAT HAS BEEN MUCH MALIGNED)
THE ENTIRE HUMAN RACE MAY BE UTTERLY INSANE (E.G., R.D. LAING)
THE PHYSICAL WORLD MAY REPRESENT NEITHER TRUTH NOR MAYA BUT SOMETHING ELSE ENTIRELY
JESUS CHRIST MAY HAVE BEEN PSYCHOTIC OR A PRETENDER, EXISTENTIAL NEUROSIS, PSYCHOLOGICAL MEGALOMANIAC, KOOK OR MYTHICAL INDIVIDUAL
ALL OF EUCLID'S AXIOMS MAY BE ARBITRARY SIMULTANEOUSLY
MOSQUITOES MAY BE SMARTER THAN MEN
STRENGTHENING THE FAMILY MAY CAUSE MORE NEUROSIS
THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE MAY FOREVER BE RUNNING UP, ITS ENERGY CONSTANTLY INCREASING & ITS ENTROPY DECREASING (E.G., THOMAS GOLD)
ENERGY CONSERVATION MAY BE CONTRAPRODUCTIVE, & A BETTER RESPONSE TO THE ENERGY CRISIS MIGHT BE TO “WASTE” ENERGY OR USE IT MAXIMALLY
EXCESSIVE SAFETY DEVICES & REGULATIONS MAY HAVE CAUSED THE THREE MILE ISLAND NUCLEAR REACTOR ACCIDENT
ALL “FICTIONS” MAY PERFORCE BE REAL—SUPERTEMPORAL, & “THE UNIVERSE OF TRUTHS” MAY BE ANIMATE
“REALITY” AS WE KNOW IT MAY BE BUT AN ALIEN ARTIFACT OR LABORATORY EXPERIMENT, OR AN ANIMATE DIORAMA IN A COSMIC MUSEUM
EVOLUTION MAY NOT QUITE HAVE ACHIEVED AUTHENTIC INTELLIGENCE WITH MAN
THE SEEMING ZILLIONS OF PARTICLES IN THE UNIVERSE MAY ALL BE THE SELFSAME PARTICLE (E.G., RICHARD FEYNMAN)
TRUTH MAY BE NOT STATIC OR UNSTABLE & EITHER EXPANDING OR CONTRACTING

notes: Charts for the Mind. Numerous smaller labels and some photographed or obscured text could not be read reliably and were omitted.
